title: The potion cauldron
excerpt: A place to mix potions together. It holds up to 3 layers, and the liquid color blends to show what's inside. What you do What happens Use a potion on a cauldron Adds one layer (up to 3). The empty bottle is returned.…

title: Tipped swords
excerpt: Dip any sword in a mixed cauldron to tip it. On each solid hit it applies all the stored effects to the target. Charges depend on how long the mixed potion lasts; short mixes give about 4 hits, long ones up to 32.
